description: This file contains data models for API requests and responses related to data upload, statistics, processing, reporting, and visualization in a data analytics platform. It defines schemas using Pydantic BaseModel for data validation and serialization.

classes.name: UploadResponse
classes.description: Response schema for file upload, containing metadata like file ID, filename, and data dimensions.

classes.name: StatsRequest
classes.description: Schema for requesting statistical summaries of a data file.

classes.name: StatsResponse
classes.description: Schema for returning statistical summaries of data columns.

classes.name: ProcessRequest
classes.description: Schema for requesting data processing with optional filtering and row limits.

classes.name: ProcessResponse
classes.description: Schema for returning processed data records.

classes.name: ReportRequest
classes.description: Schema for requesting a report, possibly sent via email, including preview options.

classes.name: ReportResponse
classes.description: Schema indicating the status of report generation and email dispatch.

classes.name: VisualizationRequest
classes.description: Schema for requesting data visualization with specified axes and chart type.

methods.name: none
methods.description: This file does not define functions or methods, only data schemas.
